svg.title: EMMAUS / V17 — TIME HELD OPEN
svg.desc: Intaglio field derived from an open editorial aperture, scripture concordance and layered time. Luke 24:27; 2 Peter 3:8. No literal scroll, flow-field or wormhole. Native SVG only.
svg.metadata: Westside Design OS / ONE paper #ded096, ink #102a43, accent #a2872a. Not approved. Measured Magazine geometry defines the actual aperture in P2; this vector field is clipped by the existing runtime.
